acquire:bucket_water.comment: Exactly four empties feed the fill below. Never take while holding water and empties together: the fill below tops up to four water from the held empties, and extra takes push the bucket total past four and break the pour counter (each pour mints one empty, scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/mud_patch.rs2:38-46). A fresh run holds neither, so it still takes to four.
Well fill is mes() chat text (scripts/general_use/scripts/water_sources.rs2:86-93); the sink2 at (2617,3325) near the garden works the same via _watersource.

steps.comment: gap_ticks 3: alrena.rs2:17-26 closes the chat (if_close) then p_delay(2) before the intervening mes (3 engine ticks; mes re-arms before later dialogue).
Buy the rope before entering the sewer; Aemad's Adventurers' Shop stocks rope.

Stray bucket_empty pollutes the pour counter below, which counts real pours as fresh empties. No water plus empties means strays: deposit the whole stack. Held water means a mid-cycle resume, so the counter empties are preserved; costs one bank trip only when strays exist.

Top up to 4 water, except on a proven mid-pour resume: 3+ held empties are pours already run (each pour mints one empty, scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/mud_patch.rs2:38-46), so the held water covers the (4 - empties) pours left and the counter stays intact. Two or fewer empties with fewer than 4 water is an interrupted well fill with 0 pours done: refill instead — the take above holds while water and empties sit together and the fill tops up to 4 from the held empties — or the pour under-runs into the no-consume default branch (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/mud_patch.rs2:35).

Each pour deletes one full bucket and adds one empty (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/mud_patch.rs2:38-46); the fourth pour reaches varp 7 with its own journal line. The empties count doubles as the pour counter: a proven resume (3+ empties) pours (4 - empties) times to varp 7 exactly as the count reaches 4, while anything else refills first (the deposit above clears no-water strays, the take holds while water and empties sit together, the fill tops up to 4), so extra pours never reach the no-consume default branch (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/mud_patch.rs2:35). Pour text is ~mesbox drained by the default dialogue.
Last surface chance to recover a banked mask before the sewer dive: the cupboard spare is refused while banked (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/cupboard.rs2:6-11).
Guarded rope recovery for a stage-7/8 resume: the only other rope buy sits in stage 03-06, and the sewer tie needs one held.

Picture recovery: the spawn refills ~instantly (respawn 5 ticks) and digging back down re-enters the sewer at any varp >= 7 (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/mud_patch.rs2:1-14). The picture is only spent at Jethick, so this trio is skipped once held.
Only runs when the climb above actually left the sewer; digging at varp >= 7 just teleports back down (spade is not consumed).
Same picture recovery as stage 8: Jethick needs the picture held (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/jethick.rs2:18-20).
Alrena's cupboard spare is refused while a mask sits in the bank (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/cupboard.rs2:6-11), so withdraw instead. Skipped in the normal flow (mask worn).

West-side picture loss: Elena's own hint is the city manhole (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/elena.rs2:63). The wall doors stay shut until Biohazard, and manhole/mud pile need no mask (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/sewerpipe.rs2:143-153 checks the hat only on east-to-west pipe entry). All skipped once the picture is held.

If resuming in the cellar without its key, return to the surface barrel before descending again.

West to east via Elena's manhole hint (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/elena.rs2:63). The cellar gate opens freely at varp >= 28 (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/plaguehouse.rs2:26-47). All steps skip once east.
Opening loc_2535 from inside walks out (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/doors.rs2:10-13).
Any closed manhole in the zone opens (scripts/areas/area_ardougne_west/scripts/manhole.rs2:5-14); the pipe crossing opens it for 500 ticks, so this often skips.
Manhole and mud pile need no worn mask; the mask check sits only on east-to-west pipe entry (scripts/quests/quest_elena/scripts/sewerpipe.rs2:143-153).
